question: The radii of two concentric circles with centre O are 26 cm and 16 cm. Chord AB of the larger circle is tangent to the smaller circle at C and AD is a diameter. What is the length of CD?
solution:
**Given:**

The radii of two concentric circles with center O are 26 cm and 16 cm.

Chord AB of the larger circle is tangent to the smaller circle at C and AD is a diameter. 

**Formula used:**

Hypotnuese² = Perpendicular² + Base² 

If a line divides any two sides in the same ratio (AO/OB = AC/CB) then the line is parallel to the third line.

DB parallel to OC

BD = 2 OC

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c905e3d081241c88b0ea7f347ce53cdcbfaa51b73c5ec0844cbbbc9779c837a1.png] 

According to the question, 

OA = OD = 26 cm

OC = 16 cm

If a line divides any two sides in the same ratio (AO/OD = AC/CB) then the line is parallel to the third line.

DB parallel to OC

BD = 2 OC

BD = 2 × OC 

⇒ BD = 2 × 16 = 32 cm.

In Δ AOC 

⇒ OA² = OC² + AC² 

⇒ 26² = 16² + AC²

⇒ AC = √420 cm

⇒ AC = BC = √420 cm. 

In Δ BCD 

⇒ CD² = BD² + BC² 

⇒ CD² = 32² + √420²

⇒ CD² = 1024 + 420

⇒ CD = √1444

⇒ CD = 38 cm

**∴ The length of the CD is 38 cm.**
